# Angular Material Enhanced

> **Copyright (c) 2026 laudebugs (https://github.com/laudebugs/ng-material-enhanced) - MIT License**
> A demonstration application and CSS/SCSS extension system illustrating how to customize Angular Material 3 components using SCSS mixin overrides.

## Overview

Angular Material Enhanced provides a structured class-based design token and override system for Angular Material 3 (`@angular/material`). It demonstrates how to add multi-tier sizing, geometric corner radius control, destructive state styling, and scalable typography/icons to standard Material 3 components without breaking their built-in accessibility, ripple effects, or theming.

- **Demo Website**: https://ng-material-enhanced.laudebugs.me
- **Compiled CSS Asset**: https://ng-material-enhanced.laudebugs.me/material-overrides.css
- **Raw SCSS Asset**: https://ng-material-enhanced.laudebugs.me/material-overrides.scss
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/laudebugs/ng-material-enhanced

---

## Sizing System

Components support unified sizing classes defined in `src/scss/sizes.scss`:

| Class | Height / Dimension | Applicable Components |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sz-xsmall` | 24px | Buttons, Button Toggle, Progress Bar, Slider, Slide Toggle |
| `sz-small` | 32px | All Components (Buttons, Toggle, Checkbox, Chips, Form Field, Progress Bar, Slider, Slide Toggle, Radios) |
| `sz-medium` | 40px | All Components (Default baseline) |
| `sz-large` | 48px | All Components |
| `sz-xlarge` | 64px | All Components |

---

## Shape & Geometry System

Components support corner radius overrides via utility classes:

| Class | Border Radius | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sh-round` | `9999px` | Fully rounded pill / capsule shape |
| `sh-squircle` | Proportional (`height / 4` or `8px`) | Smooth rounded rectangle (Default for most components) |
| `sh-square` | `0px` | Sharp corners / rectangular geometry |

---

## Modifier Classes

- `destructive`: Applies high-contrast error palette styling (`#ba1a1a` / error container colors) to Buttons and Checkboxes while maintaining Material 3 hover and ripple interactions.
- `no-hint` / `no-error`: Hides the subscript wrapper in `mat-form-field` for compact form layouts.

---

## Component Reference & Code Examples

### 1. Buttons (`mat-button`, `mat-icon-button`, `mat-fab`, `mat-mini-fab`)
Supports appearances `filled`, `tonal`, `outlined`, `elevated`/`protected`, `text`.
```html
<!-- Standard Button -->
<button matButton="filled" class="sz-medium sh-squircle">
  <mat-icon class="material-symbols-outlined">check</mat-icon>
  Submit
</button>

<!-- Destructive Button -->
<button matButton="filled" class="sz-medium sh-squircle destructive">
  <mat-icon class="material-symbols-outlined">delete</mat-icon>
  Delete Account
</button>

<!-- Icon Button -->
<button matIconButton class="sz-small sh-square" aria-label="Settings">
  <mat-icon class="material-symbols-outlined">settings</mat-icon>
</button>
```

### 2. Button Toggle (`mat-button-toggle-group`)
Supports horizontal, vertical, single, multiple selection, and icon toggles.
```html
<mat-button-toggle-group class="sz-medium sh-squircle" value="bold" aria-label="Font style">
  <mat-button-toggle value="bold">Bold</mat-button-toggle>
  <mat-button-toggle value="italic">Italic</mat-button-toggle>
  <mat-button-toggle value="underline">Underline</mat-button-toggle>
</mat-button-toggle-group>
```

### 3. Checkbox (`mat-checkbox`)
Supports sizes `sz-small`, `sz-medium`, `sz-large`, `sz-xlarge`, and `destructive`.
```html
<mat-checkbox class="sz-medium" [checked]="true">Remember me</mat-checkbox>
<mat-checkbox class="sz-medium destructive" [checked]="true">I understand the consequences</mat-checkbox>
```

### 4. Chips (`mat-chip`, `mat-chip-set`, `mat-chip-grid`)
Supports action chips, avatars, removable buttons, and chip input grids.
```html
<mat-chip-set>
  <mat-chip class="sz-medium sh-round">
    <img matChipAvatar src="avatar.jpg" alt="Avatar" />
    Jane Doe
  </mat-chip>
  <mat-chip class="sz-medium sh-squircle">
    Tag Name
    <button matChipRemove aria-label="Remove chip">
      <mat-icon class="material-symbols-outlined">cancel</mat-icon>
    </button>
  </mat-chip>
</mat-chip-set>
```

### 5. Form Field & Radios (`mat-form-field`, `mat-radio-button`)
Supports appearances `outline` and `fill`, prefix/suffix buttons, and scaled typography.
```html
<mat-form-field appearance="outline" class="sz-medium sh-squircle">
  <mat-label>Email Address</mat-label>
  <mat-icon matPrefix class="material-symbols-outlined">email</mat-icon>
  <input matInput placeholder="name@example.com">
</mat-form-field>

<mat-radio-group value="standard">
  <mat-radio-button class="sz-medium" value="standard">Standard Option</mat-radio-button>
</mat-radio-group>
```

### 6. Progress Bar (`mat-progress-bar`)
Supports modes `determinate`, `indeterminate`, `buffer`, and `query`.
```html
<mat-progress-bar mode="determinate" [value]="75" class="sz-medium sh-round"></mat-progress-bar>
<mat-progress-bar mode="buffer" [value]="40" [bufferValue]="80" class="sz-large sh-squircle"></mat-progress-bar>
```

### 7. Slider (`mat-slider`)
Supports continuous, discrete (with tick marks), and range sliders.
```html
<!-- Continuous Slider -->
<mat-slider class="sz-medium" [min]="0" [max]="100">
  <input matSliderThumb [value]="40" aria-label="Volume">
</mat-slider>

<!-- Range Slider -->
<mat-slider class="sz-medium" [min]="0" [max]="100">
  <input matSliderStartThumb [value]="20" aria-label="Min price">
  <input matSliderEndThumb [value]="80" aria-label="Max price">
</mat-slider>
```

### 8. Slide Toggle (`mat-slide-toggle`)
Supports sizes `sz-xsmall` through `sz-xlarge` with calibrated track, thumb, and touch target sizes.
```html
<mat-slide-toggle class="sz-medium" [checked]="true">Enable notifications</mat-slide-toggle>
```

---

## SCSS Architecture

The overrides leverage Angular Material 3 Sass mixins (`@use '@angular/material' as mat`):
- `mat.button-overrides(...)`
- `mat.icon-button-overrides(...)`
- `mat.fab-overrides(...)`
- `mat.button-toggle-overrides(...)`
- `mat.checkbox-overrides(...)`
- `mat.chips-overrides(...)`
- `mat.form-field-overrides(...)`
- `mat.progress-bar-overrides(...)`
- `mat.radio-overrides(...)`
- `mat.slide-toggle-overrides(...)`
- `mat.slider-overrides(...)`

All overrides are bundled via `src/scss/_mat-overrides.scss` and compiled into pure CSS via `scripts/generate-css.mjs`.

---

## Theme Color Palettes

Theme colors (such as `_theme-colors.scss`) are intentionally not bundled in the generic component overrides so that projects can define their own primary, secondary, and tertiary palettes.

To generate a custom Material 3 theme palette for your project, run the official Angular Material schematic:

```bash
ng generate @angular/material:theme-color
```

Refer to the official [Material 3 Custom Theme Schematic Documentation](https://github.com/angular/components/blob/main/src/material/schematics/ng-generate/theme-color/README.md) for full options and color specifications.

---

## Routes

- `/`: Complete showcase gallery of all components, sizes, and variations.
- `/buttons`: Interactive Button configurator with live code snippets.
- `/button-toggle`: Interactive Button Toggle configurator.
- `/checkbox`: Interactive Checkbox configurator.
- `/chips`: Interactive Chips configurator.
- `/form-field`: Interactive Form Field & Radio configurator.
- `/progress-loader`: Interactive Progress Bar configurator.
- `/slider`: Interactive Slider configurator.
- `/toggle`: Interactive Slide Toggle configurator.
- `/css`: Full compiled CSS & SCSS overrides viewer and copy tool.

---

## Raw SCSS Overrides (All-in-One Source)

The following is the complete, raw SCSS source containing all component mixins and Sass logic:

```scss
// ============================================================================
// Angular Material Enhanced - Component Overrides (All-in-One Raw SCSS)
// https://github.com/laudebugs/ng-material-enhanced
// ============================================================================

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// File: sizes.scss
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
$form-field-sizes: (
  small: 32px,
  medium: 40px,
  large: 48px,
  xlarge: 56px,
);

$button-sizes: (
  xsmall: 24px,
  small: 32px,
  medium: 40px,
  large: 48px,
  xlarge: 64px,
);

$slide-toggle-sizes: (
  xsmall: 20px,
  small: 24px,
  medium: 32px,
  large: 40px,
  xlarge: 48px,
);

$slider-sizes: (
  xsmall: 12px,
  small: 16px,
  medium: 20px,
  large: 24px,
  xlarge: 32px,
);

$progress-bar-sizes: (
  xsmall: 1px,
  small: 2px,
  medium: 4px,
  large: 6px,
  xlarge: 8px,
);

$chip-sizes: (
  small: 24px,
  medium: 32px,
  large: 40px,
  xlarge: 48px,
);


// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// File: mat-button.scss
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@use '@angular/material' as mat;
@use 'sass:map';
@use 'sass:math';
@use './sizes' as sizes;
@use './theme-colors' as theme-colors;

$error-palette: map.get(theme-colors.$primary-palette, error);
$neutral-palette: map.get(theme-colors.$primary-palette, neutral);

// a list of filled, outlined, protected, tonal so that we can loop through it
$button-variants: filled, outlined, protected, tonal, text;

@mixin configure-button($height) {
  @each $variant in $button-variants {
    @include mat.button-overrides(
      (
        #{$variant}-container-height: $height,
        #{$variant}-touch-target-size: $height + 8px,
        #{$variant}-icon-spacing: math.div($height, 5),
        #{$variant}-icon-offset: - math.div($height, 5)
      )
    );
  }

  @include mat.button-overrides(
    (
      filled-horizontal-padding: math.div($height * 3, 5),
      outlined-horizontal-padding: math.div($height * 3, 5),
      protected-horizontal-padding: math.div($height * 3, 5),
      tonal-horizontal-padding: math.div($height * 3, 5),
      text-with-icon-horizontal-padding: math.div($height * 4, 10),
    )
  );

  .material-symbols-outlined {
    font-size: math.div($height * 3, 5);
  }
  mat-icon {
    font-size: math.div($height * 3, 5);
    width: math.div($height * 3, 5);
    height: math.div($height * 3, 5);
  }
  &[matIconButton] {
    @include mat.icon-button-overrides(
      (
        state-layer-size: $height,
        icon-size: math.div($height * 3, 5),
        touch-target-size: $height + 4px,
      )
    );
  }

  $fab-height: math.div($height * 7, 5);

  &[matFab] {
    @include mat.fab-overrides(
      (
        extended-container-height: $fab-height,
        touch-target-size: math.div($fab-height + 4px, 1),
        small-touch-target-size: math.div($fab-height + 4px, 1),
      )
    );
    .material-symbols-outlined {
      font-size: math.div($height * 4, 5);
    }
    mat-icon {
      font-size: math.div($height * 4, 5);
      width: math.div($height * 4, 5);
      height: math.div($height * 4, 5);
    }
    &.mat-mdc-fab-base {
      height: $fab-height;
      &:not([extended]) {
        width: $fab-height;
      }
    }
  }
  &[matMiniFab] {
    &.mat-mdc-fab-base {
      height: $height;
      width: $height;
    }
    @include mat.fab-overrides(
      (
        extended-container-height: $height,
        touch-target-size: $height + 4px,
        small-touch-target-size: $height + 4px,
      )
    );
  }

  &.sh-round {
    @include mat.button-overrides(
      (
        filled-container-shape: 9999px,
        outlined-container-shape: 9999px,
        protected-container-shape: 9999px,
        text-container-shape: 9999px,
        tonal-container-shape: 9999px,
      )
    );
    @include mat.icon-button-overrides(
      (
        container-shape: 9999px,
      )
    );
    @include mat.fab-overrides(
      (
        container-shape: 9999px,
        extended-container-shape: 9999px,
        small-container-shape: 9999px,
      )
    );
  }
  &.sh-square {
    @include mat.button-overrides(
      (
        filled-container-shape: 0px,
        outlined-container-shape: 0px,
        protected-container-shape: 0px,
        text-container-shape: 0px,
        tonal-container-shape: 0px,
      )
    );
    @include mat.icon-button-overrides(
      (
        container-shape: 0px,
      )
    );
    @include mat.fab-overrides(
      (
        container-shape: 0px,
        extended-container-shape: 0px,
        small-container-shape: 0px,
      )
    );
  }
  // if doesn't have shape attribute, set the default shape to rounded corners
  &.sh-squircle,
  &:not(.sh-round):not(.sh-square):not(.sh-squircle) {
    @include mat.button-overrides(
      (
        filled-container-shape: math.div($height, 4),
        outlined-container-shape: math.div($height, 4),
        protected-container-shape: math.div($height, 4),
        text-container-shape: math.div($height, 4),
        tonal-container-shape: math.div($height, 4),
      )
    );
    @include mat.icon-button-overrides(
      (
        container-shape: math.div($height, 4),
      )
    );
    @include mat.fab-overrides(
      (
        container-shape: math.div($fab-height, 4),
        extended-container-shape: math.div($fab-height, 4),
        small-container-shape: math.div($fab-height, 4),
      )
    );
  }
  &.destructive {
    @include mat.button-overrides(
      (
        filled-container-color: map.get($error-palette, 40),
        filled-state-layer-color: color-mix(
            in srgb,
            map.get($error-palette, 100) 8%,
            map.get($error-palette, 40)
          ),
        filled-ripple-color: color-mix(
            in srgb,
            map.get($error-palette, 100) 12%,
            map.get($error-palette, 40)
          ),
        tonal-container-color: map.get($error-palette, 90),
        tonal-label-text-color: map.get($error-palette, 40),
        tonal-state-layer-color: color-mix(
            in srgb,
            map.get($error-palette, 30) 8%,
            map.get($error-palette, 90)
          ),
        tonal-ripple-color: color-mix(
            in srgb,
            map.get($error-palette, 30) 12%,
            map.get($error-palette, 90)
          ),
        outlined-outline-color: map.get($error-palette, 40),
        outlined-ripple-color: color-mix(in srgb, map.get($error-palette, 40) 12%, transparent),
        outlined-state-layer-color: color-mix(in srgb, map.get($error-palette, 40) 8%, transparent),
        outlined-label-text-color: map.get($error-palette, 40),
        protected-label-text-color: map.get($error-palette, 40),
        protected-state-layer-color: color-mix(
            in srgb,
            map.get($error-palette, 40) 8%,
            map.get($neutral-palette, 96)
          ),
        protected-ripple-color: color-mix(
            in srgb,
            map.get($error-palette, 40) 12%,
            map.get($neutral-palette, 96)
          ),
      )
    );

    @include mat.icon-button-overrides(
      (
        icon-color: map.get($error-palette, 40),
        ripple-color: color-mix(in srgb, map.get($error-palette, 40) 12%, transparent),
        state-layer-color: color-mix(in srgb, map.get($error-palette, 40) 8%, transparent),
      )
    );

    @include mat.fab-overrides(
      (
        container-color: map.get($error-palette, 80),
        foreground-color: map.get($error-palette, 40),
        ripple-color: color-mix(in srgb, map.get($error-palette, 40) 12%, transparent),
        state-layer-color: color-mix(in srgb, map.get($error-palette, 40) 8%, transparent),
      )
    );
  }
}

// function that loops through all the button sizes and applies the overrides
@mixin button-overrides($sizes) {
  @each $size, $height in $sizes {
    &.sz-#{$size} {
      @include configure-button($height);
    }
  }
}

button {
  &[matButton],
  &[matIconButton],
  &[matFab],
  &[matMiniFab] {
    // use function to apply overrides for all sizes
    @include button-overrides(sizes.$button-sizes);
  }
}


// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// File: mat-button-toggle.scss
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@use '@angular/material' as mat;
@use 'sass:math';
@use './sizes.scss' as sizes;


@mixin button-toggle-overrides($sizes) {
  @each $size, $height in $sizes {
    &.sz-#{$size} {
      @include mat.button-toggle-overrides(
        (
          height: $height,
        )
      );
      .material-symbols-outlined {
        font-size: math.div($height * 3, 5);
      }
      mat-icon {
        font-size: math.div($height * 3, 5);
        width: math.div($height * 3, 5);
        height: math.div($height * 3, 5);
      }
    }
  }
  &.sh-round {
    @include mat.button-toggle-overrides(
      (
        shape: 9999px,
      )
    );
  }
  &.sh-square {
    @include mat.button-toggle-overrides(
      (
        shape: 0px,
      )
    );
  }
  &.sh-squircle,
  &:not(.sh-round):not(.sh-square):not(.sh-squircle) {
    @include mat.button-toggle-overrides(
      (
        shape: 8px,
      )
    );
  }
}

mat-button-toggle-group {
  // use function to apply overrides for all sizes
  @include button-toggle-overrides(sizes.$button-sizes);
}


// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// File: mat-checkbox.scss
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@use '@angular/material' as mat;
@use 'sass:math';
@use 'sass:map';
@use './theme-colors' as theme-colors;
@use './sizes.scss' as sizes;

$neutral-palette: map.get(theme-colors.$primary-palette, neutral);
$error-palette: map.get(theme-colors.$primary-palette, error);

@mixin configure-check-box($height) {
  @include mat.checkbox-overrides(
    (
      state-layer-size: $height,
      touch-target-size: $height + 8px,
    )
  );
}

@mixin check-box-overrides($sizes) {
  @each $size, $height in $sizes {
    &.sz-#{$size} {
      @include configure-check-box($height);
    }
  }
}

mat-checkbox {
  // use function to apply overrides for all sizes
  @include check-box-overrides(sizes.$form-field-sizes);

  // if no size attribute, use the medium size as default
  &:not(.sz-small):not(.sz-medium):not(.sz-large):not(.sz-xlarge) {
    $medium-height: map.get(sizes.$form-field-sizes, medium);
    @include configure-check-box($medium-height);
  }

   &.destructive {
    @include mat.checkbox-overrides(
      (
        selected-hover-icon-color: map.get($error-palette, 40),
        selected-icon-color: map.get($error-palette, 40),
        selected-focus-icon-color: map.get($error-palette, 40),
        selected-pressed-icon-color: map.get($error-palette, 40),
        selected-checkmark-color: map.get($error-palette, 90),
        selected-focus-state-layer-color: color-mix(in srgb, map.get($error-palette, 40) 8%, map.get($neutral-palette, 96)),
        selected-pressed-state-layer-color: color-mix(in srgb, map.get($error-palette, 40) 12%, map.get($neutral-palette, 96)),
        unselected-pressed-state-layer-color: map.get($error-palette, 40)
      )
    );
  }
}



// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// File: mat-chip.scss
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@use '@angular/material' as mat;
@use 'sass:math';
@use 'sass:map';
@use './sizes.scss' as sizes;
@use './mat-button.scss' as button-overrides;

@mixin configure-chip($height) {
  @include mat.chips-overrides(
    (
      container-height: $height,
      // chip-touch-target-size: $height + 8px,
      container-shape-radius: math.div($height, 4),
      with-avatar-avatar-shape-radius: math.div($height * 3, 4),
      with-avatar-avatar-size: math.div($height * 3, 4),
      with-icon-icon-size: calc($height * 9 / 16),
    )
  );

  button {
    &[matChipEdit],
    &[matChipRemove] {
      @include button-overrides.configure-button($height);
      height: calc($height * 9 / 16);
      width: calc($height * 9 / 16);
    }
  }
  &.sh-round {
    @include mat.chips-overrides(
      (
        container-shape-radius: 9999px,
      )
    );
  }
  &.sh-square {
    @include mat.chips-overrides(
      (
        container-shape-radius: 0px,
      )
    );
  }
  &.sh-squircle,
  &:not(.sh-round):not(.sh-square):not(.sh-squircle) {
    @include mat.chips-overrides(
      (
        container-shape-radius: math.div($height, 4),
      )
    );
  }
}

@mixin chip-overrides($sizes) {
  @each $size, $height in $sizes {
    &.sz-#{$size} {
      @include configure-chip($height);
    }
  }
}

mat-chip,
mat-chip-row {
  // use function to apply overrides for all sizes
  @include chip-overrides(sizes.$chip-sizes);

  // if no size class, use the medium size as default
  &:not(.sz-small):not(.sz-medium):not(.sz-large):not(.sz-xlarge) {
    $medium-height: map.get(sizes.$chip-sizes, medium);
    @include configure-chip($medium-height);
  }
}




// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// File: mat-form-field.scss
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@use '@angular/material' as mat;
@use 'sass:map';
@use 'sass:math';
@use './sizes' as sizes;
@use './mat-button.scss' as button-overrides;

@mixin configure-form-field($height) {
  $input-height: calc($height * 2 / 3);
  // if size is small and not appearance outline, set height to 40px;

  @include mat.form-field-overrides(
    (
      container-height: $height,
      container-text-size: 1em,
      filled-label-text-size: 0.9rem,
      container-vertical-padding: math.div(($height - $input-height), 2),
      filled-with-label-container-padding-top: calc(($height - $input-height) * 3 / 4),
      filled-with-label-container-padding-bottom: calc(($height - $input-height) / 4),
    )
  );
  &.sh-squircle,
  &:not(.sh-square):not(.sh-squircle) {
    @include mat.form-field-overrides(
      (
        // BORDER RADIUS OF FORM FIELD
        outlined-container-shape: math.div($height, 8),
        filled-container-shape: math.div($height, 8)
      )
    );
  }
  &.sh-square {
    @include mat.form-field-overrides(
      (
        // BORDER RADIUS OF FORM FIELD
        outlined-container-shape: 0px,
        filled-container-shape: 0px
      )
    );
  }

  &.no-hint, &.no-error {
    .mat-mdc-form-field-subscript-wrapper {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  .mat-mdc-form-field-icon-prefix > .mat-icon, .mat-mdc-form-field-icon-suffix > .mat-icon {
    padding: 0 calc($height / 8);
  }
  input.mat-mdc-input-element.mat-mdc-input-element {
    height: $input-height;
  }
  .mat-mdc-text-field-wrapper {
    padding-left: calc($height/4);
  }
  .mat-mdc-form-field-flex,
  .mat-mdc-text-field-wrapper,
  .mat-mdc-form-field-infix {
    // WE want to target only input elements and not text areas
    &:has(input[matInput]) {
      height: $height;
    }
  }

  mat-select,
  mat-select > .mat-mdc-select-trigger {
    min-height: $input-height;
  }
  mat-option {
    min-height: $height;
  }
}

@mixin form-field-overrides($sizes) {
  align-self: flex-start;

  @each $size, $height in $sizes {
    &.sz-#{$size} {
      @include configure-form-field($height);
    }
  }
}

@mixin form-field-button-without-size-config($height) {
  button {
    &[matButton],
    &[matIconButton],
    &[matFab],
    &[matMiniFab] {
      // doesn't have size class, use the size of the form field to determine the button size
      &:not(.sz-xsmall):not(.sz-small):not(.sz-medium):not(.sz-large):not(.sz-xlarge) {
        @include button-overrides.configure-button($height);
      }
    }
  }
}

mat-form-field {
  // use function to apply overrides for all sizes
  @include form-field-overrides(sizes.$form-field-sizes);

  // apply button overrides to the buttons inside the form field based on form-field size
  @each $size, $height in sizes.$form-field-sizes {
    &.sz-#{$size} {
      @include form-field-button-without-size-config($height);
    }
  }
  // if no size class, use the medium size as default
  &:not(.sz-small):not(.sz-medium):not(.sz-large):not(.sz-xlarge) {
    $medium-height: map.get(sizes.$form-field-sizes, medium);
    @include configure-form-field($medium-height);
    @include form-field-button-without-size-config($medium-height);
  }
}
```
